verdicts.reason: A has a sensible left-to-right flow: copy, then the product, then the CTA. But the sale ribbon sits right on top of the headline with no breathing room, the headline leaves 'last' orphaned on its own line, and the logo is tiny and crammed into a decorative circle in the corner. B gives the headline strong presence, but it shrinks the bottle to a thumbnail jammed against the top-right edge on top of a circle, leaves the sale ribbon floating with no anchor in the middle, and packs body copy, CTA and legal text into a crowded right column whose fine print is nearly as big as the body copy.
